tools.name: get_trust_manifest
tools.description: Free, read-only entry point. Call this first when deciding whether Agent Transaction Trust fits an x402 purchase. Returns capabilities, supported authority modes, proof key, price/network information, and the endpoints needed for transaction clearance, authorization, and settlement verification.

tools.name: create_ap2_challenge
tools.description: Free prerequisite for AP2-native transaction clearance or authorization. Call before clearance_x402_ap2 or authorize_x402_ap2, bind the returned challenge into the AP2 Payment Mandate proof, then pass that challenge token as ap2_authority.challenge_token. tools.name: verify_trust_token
tools.description: Free, read-only token check. Use this to validate the signature and expiry of a Trust policy, authorization token, transaction clearance token, or settlement receipt; it does not perform on-chain settlement verification.

tools.name: verify_settlement
tools.description: Free post-payment step. Call only after the merchant x402 payment for a previously approved authorization or transaction clearance. Verifies the Base USDC settlement on-chain and, when it matches the authorization, returns a signed settlement receipt. The authorization_token may come from clearance_

tools.name: agent_access_gateway
tools.description: Paid external capability access via x402. First choose a supported capability: onesource.block_number, onesource.erc20_balance or onesource.allowance. Input network, when specified, must be ethereum, sepolia or robinhood; it is distinct from the Base network for payment. Machine price: $0.006.

tools.name: transaction_preflight
tools.description: Paid pre-sign simulation for an unsigned Base transaction. Call immediately before the wallet signs. Returns signed EXECUTE, REVIEW or BLOCK with current-state simulation, gas, revert, balance, nonce and approval-risk evidence. Machine price: $0.002 via x402.

tools.name: token_transaction_verdict
tools.description: Paid Base token safety check for autonomous agents. Call immediately before buying or swapping an unfamiliar ERC-20 token to screen honeypot, sell-restriction, tax, blacklist/pause and admin-risk signals. Returns signed ALLOW, WARN or BLOCK evidence. Machine price: $0.005 via x402.

tools.name: firewall_before_payment
tools.description: Paid automatic before-payment gate for x402 clients. Call after receiving the merchant's real PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge but before creating/signing the merchant payment. Returns firewall_action ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK plus signed proof. ALLOW means the wallet/client may proceed only if its own spend

tools.name: preflight_x402
tools.description: Paid public preflight for an autonomous x402 payment. No account, API key, policy token, or AP2 mandate is required. Submit the merchant's real PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge and the exact intended HTTP request. Returns preflight_decision APPROVED, REVIEW or DENIED plus a signed preflight_token. APPROVE

tools.name: clearance_x402_ap2
tools.description: Paid transaction-clearance decision for an autonomous x402 purchase. Use after create_ap2_challenge and after receiving the merchant's real PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge, but before paying the merchant. Verifies AP2 v0.2 authority, exact request/challenge integrity, and public merchant-risk evidence. R

tools.name: authorize_x402_ap2
tools.description: Paid pre-payment trust gate. Use after create_ap2_challenge and after receiving the merchant's real x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge, but before paying the merchant. Verifies AP2 v0.2 authority and binds approval to the exact merchant challenge and HTTP request. On approval returns authorization_toke
